policy: exact metric key only; no fuzzy alias inference; unknown remains unknown

kube_pod_container_resource_requests.definition: Configured container resource request, not measured resource consumption.

kube_pod_container_resource_limits.definition: Configured container resource limit, not measured resource consumption.

kube_pod_container_status_ready.definition: Whether the container readiness check succeeded.

kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total.definition: Cumulative container restarts; a counter decrease is a reset, not a negative restart.

container_cpu_usage_seconds_total.definition: Cumulative CPU time consumed; this is not instantaneous CPU utilization.

container_memory_usage_bytes.definition: Current container memory usage including cached memory.
